Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; products exist
Steps: Open Admin Product Management; observe product list
ExpectedResult: Product list is displayed with product name, price, category, and available actions
ActualResult: Admin Product Management opened and displayed seeded product rows with edit/delete actions.

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; at least one category exists
Input: operation=create; name=FR15 Test Product; price=100000; category=existing; optional fields empty
Steps: Open Product Management; create product with valid required fields; save; observe list
ExpectedResult: Product is created and appears in product list with correct required fields
ActualResult: Created valid product with required fields; product appeared in the Admin product list.

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; at least one category exists
Input: operation=create; valid name/price/category; description and imageUrl provided
Steps: Create product with all supported fields populated; save; view product list/detail if available
ExpectedResult: Product is created and all provided fields are stored/displayed safely
ActualResult: Created product with name, price, category, description, and image URL; product appeared in the list.

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; product with same name already exists
Steps: Create another product using an existing product name
ExpectedResult: System handles duplicate name consistently without corrupting product list; if duplicates are not allowed, a clear validation error is shown
ActualResult: Duplicate product name was allowed; no product list corruption was observed. FR-15 does not require name uniqueness.

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; at least one category exists
Steps: Create product with script-looking name; view product list
ExpectedResult: Script-looking name is rejected or displayed as text; no script is executed
ActualResult: Script-looking product name was saved and displayed as literal text; no script execution was observed.

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; at least one category exists
Input: operation=create; valid name/price/category; empty description; empty imageUrl
Steps: Create product with required fields only and optional fields empty
ExpectedResult: Product creation follows required-field rules; optional fields do not block creation unless another requirement says so
ActualResult: Product with required fields only and empty optional fields was created successfully.

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; at least one category exists
Steps: Attempt to create product with empty name
ExpectedResult: Product is rejected; no new product is created
ActualResult: Browser required validation blocked empty name; no new product was created.

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; at least one category exists
Steps: Attempt to create product with whitespace-only name
ExpectedResult: Product is rejected after trimming; no new product is created
ActualResult: Whitespace-only name was accepted and created a product row.

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; at least one category exists
Steps: Attempt to create product with non-numeric price
ExpectedResult: Product is rejected; no new product is created
ActualResult: UI number input rejected non-numeric price before submit.

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated
Steps: Attempt to create product without selecting category
ExpectedResult: Product is rejected; no new product is created
ActualResult: Blocked: Admin UI category dropdown always selects an existing default category; missing/unselected category cannot be produced from UI.

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; API or setup can send category_id directly
Steps: Attempt to create product with non-existing category ID
ExpectedResult: Product is rejected; no product is created with invalid category reference
ActualResult: Blocked: Admin UI cannot submit arbitrary non-existing category_id such as 999999; direct API would be required.

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; target product A and non-target product B exist
Steps: Record Product A and B values; update Product A; observe list
ExpectedResult: Product A values change to new values
ActualResult: After updating Product A, the updated product name appeared in the Admin product list.

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; target product A and non-target product B exist
Input: operation=update_isolation; target=Product A; observe Product B
Steps: Record Product B before updating Product A; update Product A; compare Product B after update
ExpectedResult: Only Product A changes; Product B remains unchanged
ActualResult: Immediate list after updating Product A showed many rows renamed to the new Product A name; Product B was no longer visible by its original name.

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; target product exists
Input: operation=update_optional_fields; valid required fields; new description/imageUrl
Steps: Update description and imageUrl for selected product
ExpectedResult: Selected product optional fields update safely without changing unrelated products
ActualResult: Updated optional fields and required fields for the selected product; updated row was visible.

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; no product with ID 999999 exists
Steps: Attempt to update a non-existing product
ExpectedResult: Update is rejected with clear error; no product data changes
ActualResult: Blocked: Admin UI does not expose editing a non-existing product ID such as 999999.

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; disposable product exists
Steps: Delete selected disposable product; observe product list
ExpectedResult: Selected product is removed from product list
ActualResult: Deleted a disposable product; the deleted product was no longer visible in the list.

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; product was already deleted or ID does not exist
Steps: Attempt to delete non-existing/deleted product
ExpectedResult: Delete is rejected or safely no-ops with clear behavior; product list remains valid
ActualResult: Blocked: Admin UI does not expose deleting a product that is already absent or non-existing.

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; at least one category exists
Steps: Create valid product; remain on Product Management screen
ExpectedResult: New product is visible immediately or after clear refresh
ActualResult: After creating a valid product through Admin UI, the new product appeared in Product Management without manual database inspection.

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; product exists
Steps: Update selected product; remain on Product Management screen
ExpectedResult: Updated values are visible in list without duplicate rows
ActualResult: Immediate update list showed many rows with the updated product name instead of exactly one updated row.

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; disposable product exists
Steps: Delete selected product; remain on Product Management screen
ExpectedResult: Deleted product disappears from list immediately or after clear refresh
ActualResult: Product list refreshed after delete; deleted row was not visible.

Preconditions: No user is authenticated
Steps: Open Admin Product Management or attempt product write action without login
ExpectedResult: Access/write action is rejected; product data is unchanged
ActualResult: After logout/opening Admin Web, Admin Login was shown and product management controls were not available.

Preconditions: Normal non-admin user session exists
Steps: Attempt to access Admin Product Management or perform write action as normal user
ExpectedResult: Access/write action is rejected; product data is unchanged
ActualResult: Normal user credentials were rejected by Admin Web; the browser remained on Admin Login.

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; category can become stale/deleted through setup
Steps: Attempt to save product with stale/deleted category reference
ExpectedResult: Product save is rejected or category list refresh prevents selecting stale category
ActualResult: Blocked: Admin UI category dropdown only shows existing categories and does not allow selecting a stale/deleted category.

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; product edit form supports cancel/close without saving
Input: operation=edit_cancel; change fields but do not save
Steps: Open edit form; modify values; cancel/close; reopen product
ExpectedResult: Product values remain unchanged because save was not confirmed
ActualResult: After canceling edit, original product remained visible and the unsaved name was not visible.

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; at least one category exists
Steps: Attempt to create product with missing/empty price
ExpectedResult: Product is rejected because price is required; no new product is created
ActualResult: Empty price submitted through UI and created a product.

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; at least one category exists

ExpectedResult: Robustness result is recorded; product should not crash UI/API or corrupt product list

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; at least one category exists

ActualResult: Broken image URL did not block creation; product appeared in the list and UI handled image display safely.

Preconditions: No user is authenticated; API execution is allowed for this design case

ExpectedResult: Write action is rejected and product data is unchanged
ActualResult: Blocked: Unauthenticated direct POST /api/products is API-only and not reachable from Admin UI functional flow.

Preconditions: Normal non-admin user session exists; API execution is allowed for this design case
Steps: Send create product request with non-admin user session/token
ExpectedResult: Write action is rejected and product data is unchanged
ActualResult: Blocked: Non-admin direct POST /api/products is API-only and not reachable from Admin UI functional flow.

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; API or setup can omit category_id

ExpectedResult: Product is rejected because category is required; no product is created without a valid category reference
ActualResult: Blocked: Admin UI always sends the selected category value; missing category_id requires direct API manipulation.

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; target product A and non-target product B exist
